question: Technical writing cho AI documentation cần tuân thủ nguyên tắc gì?
options: Clear, concise, audience-appropriate. Dùng plain language cho non-technical stakeholders. Include: purpose, limitations, intended use, examples, NOT just technical specs
explanation: Bad: 'Model uses multi-head attention with 12 layers'. Good: 'System analyzes customer messages and suggests responses. Accuracy: 92% for billing questions, 78% for technical issues. Limitations: struggles with sarcasm.'

question: Khi present AI results cho C-level executives (non-technical), focus vào gì?
options: Chi tiết thuật toán và hyperparameters
Business impact: ROI, efficiency gains, risk reduction. Visualize kết quả rõ ràng. Nêu limitations honestly. Actionable recommendations, KHÔNG đi sâu vào technical details
explanation: Executives care: 'Model này có giúp tăng revenue 15% không?' KHÔNG phải 'AUC-ROC = 0.87'. Translate metrics → business language. Show: before/after impact, confidence level, risks/limitations, next steps.

question: Model Card (documentation) nên include gì cho users?
options: Intended use cases (VÀ out-of-scope uses), performance across demographics, known limitations, training data description, ethical considerations, how to report issues
explanation: Template: Model details | Intended use | Metrics | Training data | Ethical considerations | Caveats. VD: 'Model works best for English text. Performance drops 15% for non-English. NOT suitable for legal document analysis.'

question: Datasheets for Datasets (Gebru et al.) document những gì?
options: Motivation (tại sao thu thập), Composition (demographics, biases), Collection process (consent, method), Preprocessing, Uses (recommended/prohibited), Distribution, Maintenance
explanation: 'Who collected the data? Were subjects consented? What demographics are represented/underrepresented? Is there labeling noise? Sensitive data? Who maintains it?' Transparency about data limitations prevents downstream harms.

question: Visualize model performance cho stakeholders nên dùng gì?
options: Confusion matrix heatmap, ROC curve, feature importance bar chart, error analysis examples, before/after comparison. Show CONCRETE EXAMPLES of correct and incorrect predictions
explanation: Non-technical stakeholders understand examples better than metrics. Show: 'Here are 5 predictions model got right, here are 5 it got wrong. Pattern: struggles with handwritten text.' Concrete > Abstract.

question: README.md cho ML project nên có những section gì?
options: Overview, Installation, Quick Start, Data requirements, Model training, Evaluation results, API usage, Contributing guidelines, License, Citation
explanation: Good README is first impression. Quick Start (3-5 lines to run), Requirements (dependencies, hardware), Results (table/image), Reproducibility (seed, exact commands). Badge: CI status, coverage, license.

question: Jupyter Notebook best practices cho reproducibility?
options: Clear all outputs, restart kernel, run all from top to bottom before sharing. Pin dependencies (requirements.txt), set random seeds, document assumptions in markdown cells
explanation: Common antipattern: cells run out of order → works for author, breaks for others. Restart + Run All ensures linear reproducibility. Version: papermill for parameterized runs. nbstripout: git-friendly notebooks.

question: Khi giải thích uncertainty/confidence cho non-technical audience, nên làm gì?
options: Dùng plain language: 'Model confident 90% đây là fraud → recommend human review cho 10% uncertain cases'. Visualize bằng traffic light (green/yellow/red). KHÔNG ẩn giấu uncertainty
explanation: Never oversell model: 'AI says fraud' vs 'AI flags 90% chance of fraud — human should verify'. Communicate confidence intervals, error margins. Under-promise, over-deliver. Trust built through honesty about limitations.

question: API documentation (Swagger/OpenAPI) cho ML model serving cần gì?
options: Endpoint description, request/response schema, authentication, rate limits, error codes, example requests/responses, model version info, latency expectations
explanation: POST /predict: {input: 'text', max_tokens: 100} → {output: 'result', confidence: 0.95, model_version: '2.1'}. Error: 429 Rate Limit, 422 Validation Error. Swagger UI: interactive try-it-out. Good docs = adoption.

question: Post-mortem document cho ML incidents nên gồm gì?
options: Blameless: Timeline (khi nào phát hiện, khi nào fix), Root cause analysis, Impact assessment, Remediation actions, Prevention measures (monitoring, tests to add). Share learnings across team
explanation: Good post-mortem: blameless culture → people report incidents freely. 5 Whys technique for root cause. Action items: add monitoring alert, add test case, update runbook. Shared document → team learns from failures.

question: Khi demo AI product cho khách hàng, best practice gì?
options: Show cả success cases VÀ failure modes/limitations upfront. Demo với real-world data (không cherry-picked). Giải thích model confidence. Set realistic expectations
explanation: Under-promise, over-deliver. 'Model handles 85% cases automatically. 15% flagged for human review.' Customer appreciates honesty → builds trust. Cherry-picked demo → customer disappointed post-deployment → lost trust.

question: Code review best practices cho ML code?
options: Review code nhanh nhất có thể

Review: data pipeline correctness, feature leakage checks, train/test split logic, metric calculation, random seed reproducibility, hardcoded assumptions. ML-specific: not just code quality but scientific correctness
explanation: ML bugs subtle: test data in training (leakage), wrong metric, off-by-one in sliding window, using future data. Code review checklist: Is evaluation fair? Is data split temporal? Are features leaking target? Can results be reproduced?
